description: Introduction and overview of the Virginia-class Submarine: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Virginia class — 22+ built and in production — is the U.S. Navy's current attack submarine: quieter than the Los Angeles class, with photonics masts instead of periscopes and modular construction. Block V boats add the Virginia Payload Module with 28 more missile tubes. It is the backbone of the future submarine fleet.
